headline: Heirs Sue Auschwitz Museum Over Art Their Mother Made Under the Nazis
context: Josef Mengele, the “Angel of Death” doctor, ordered Dina Gottliebova Babbitt, an Auschwitz prisoner, to create watercolor paintings. Her daughters want them back.

sources.name: The New York Times
